notes.title: The Cinematic Video is Now Live!
notes.content:
**[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190626/55f29a6e482290c4acf6f3a0ab4aa8984a2a2c9a.png[/img]
We are excited to share with you the new trailer for our game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3207800/Madness_of_the_Science/][b]Madness of the Science[/b][/url]! In this trailer, you will discover the intense world of our story-driven FPS game, where you, as the sole surviving scientist of a laboratory explosion, will battle against mutants and malfunctioning AI robots.

Don’t forget to watch the trailer and experience this thrilling adventure firsthand! ⬇️
https://youtu.be/_1DdJD9nPKM**

[h2]Don't Forget to Add to Your Wishlist![/h2]
Be sure to check out our game on Steam and add it to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3207800/Madness_of_the_Science/

[h2]Community:[/h2]
Also, feel free to join our Discord community!
[url=https://discord.gg/wsgp7dmQEU][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45190626/0b4b28d0b2b9470b0f6e80b4a7296525cf4b2a5c.png[/img][/url]

Stay tuned, goodbye!
